executive_summary.product: mesh4s is a Scala library for immutable, identity-safe, oriented triangular surface topology, its geometric realizations, and its intrinsic piecewise-Euclidean metrics.
executive_summary.problem: The current ecosystem has finite identity in locus4s, grid geometry in image4s, transformations in reframe4s, and abstract adjacency in graph4s, but it has no foundational owner for oriented two-dimensional incidence. ScalaFIM surface currently fills that gap with a parallel vertex, field, subset, mapping, and adjacency system.
executive_summary.solution: mesh4s will make TriangleTopology the trusted owner of vertex, edge, face, and face-halfedge domains. SurfaceRealization will attach packed coordinates in a typed spatial frame. PiecewiseEuclideanMetric will represent intrinsic edge-length geometry. Arbitrary cell data will use locus4s Field and related finite-domain structures.
executive_summary.release_thesis: Version 0.1 will support immutable oriented triangular 2-manifolds, including disconnected surfaces and surfaces with boundary, while excluding unused vertices and nonmanifold topology from the trusted representation.

terminology.meaning: A typed coordinate frame that owns the meaning and identity of Point and Vec coordinates.
terminology.disambiguation: This type is unrelated to frame4s, an existing typed dataframe library in the Scala ecosystem.

terminology.meaning: One directed edge occurrence belonging to one triangle face. mesh4s stores exactly three face-halfedges per face and does not synthesize exterior boundary halfedges.
A structural digest of vertex count and ordered triangle rows. It is not an owner identity or permission to transport indices.

ecosystem_findings.finding: FiniteDomain, owner-safe opaque Index values, DomainKey, registries, alignments, Field, Selection, typed maps, and Relation already provide the finite-data substrate required by mesh4s.
image4s-geometry currently contains both neutral spatial concepts and image-grid-specific concepts. The neutral concepts must move to spatial4s before mesh4s-geometry freezes its public API.

reframe4s imports the current image4s geometry namespace throughout its source tree. Moving Frame, Point, Vec, and affine primitives requires a coordinated migration rather than a source-only package rename.
IndexedGraph vertex and edge identifiers belong to one compiled CSR snapshot. They are appropriate for graph algorithms but not for persisted scientific mesh-cell identity.
frame4s is an existing typed dataframe library. It is unrelated to spatial coordinate frames even though spatial4s will expose a central type named Frame.
ScalaFIM surface currently owns parallel VertexId, FaceId, SurfaceField, ROI, mapping, topology, and geometry structures, then converts selected values into locus4s.

planning_constraints: The inspected image4s, graph4s, reframe4s, and ScalaFIM directories contain unpublished or uncommitted work and must not be treated as stable released contracts.
Dependency revisions must be verified from a fresh checkout before release claims are made.
mesh4s-core must be able to progress while spatial4s is being extracted.
mesh4s-geometry must not freeze or release against a second, mesh-specific frame identity system.
Documentation must distinguish spatial4s.Frame, which represents a coordinate frame, from the unrelated frame4s typed dataframe library.

needs: Construct a trusted oriented manifold topology from triangle rows.
Attach typed fields to vertices, edges, faces, or corners without creating another data hierarchy.
Use topology-owned indices that cannot be confused with another topology or another cell kind.
Represent white, pial, inflated, and spherical coordinates as realizations of one topology.
Attach thickness, labels, masks, searchlights, and correspondences to the correct finite domain.
Interoperate safely with image grids and typed transformations.
Traverse oriented incidence without allocation of cell wrapper objects.
Operate on an intrinsic metric without requiring ambient vertex positions.
Build later DEC, FEM, geodesic, and spectral operators from signed incidence and metric data.
Inspect malformed triangle tables without pretending they are trusted manifolds.
Receive bounded structural diagnostics with concrete witnesses.
Invoke orientation or compaction as explicit transformations that return correspondence evidence.

goals.goal: Provide one trusted topology owner for oriented triangular manifold incidence.
Use locus4s directly for cell identity, fields, subsets, maps, relations, restoration, and alignment.
Separate topology, ambient realization, intrinsic metric, and attached data.
Support multiple coordinate realizations of one topology without relying on equal vertex counts as compatibility evidence.
Expose deterministic, allocation-conscious traversal suitable for JVM and Scala.js numerical kernels.
Provide persistence and explicit alignment without making ordinary equality perform a structural scan.
Integrate with graph4s through explicit primal and dual projections without making graph adjacency a second source of truth.
Prove the design through a representative ScalaFIM cortical-surface workflow before releasing 0.1.

priority_definitions.P0: Required for the 0.1 release. Work may not be omitted without revising the PRD.
priority_definitions.P1: Included in the planned 0.1 scope. It may be removed only through an explicit scope decision that preserves the central product contract.
priority_definitions.deferred: Not part of 0.1 and must not delay its release gates.

success_measures.measure: Every accepted TriangleTopology satisfies the optimized and independent-reference manifold courts.
JVM and Scala.js agree on deterministic cell ordering, traversal checksums, records, and fingerprints.
Primitive topology and coordinate traversal allocates no wrapper object per visited cell.
The representative ScalaFIM workflow uses one topology for white, pial, inflated, and spherical realizations and contains no second public vertex, field, or adjacency authority.
A fresh checkout builds all release artifacts and executable documentation from immutable dependency revisions.

non_goals_for_0_1: Silent orientation repair, invalid-face dropping, or implicit vertex compaction.
Decimation, remeshing, subdivision, or topology editing.
A core dependency on graph4s, Gale, Ravel, image4s, reframe4s, or ScalaFIM.
Format-specific neuroimaging policy in the core library.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: The canonical trusted topology is an immutable oriented triangular 2-manifold, possibly disconnected and possibly with boundary.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Nonmanifold, inconsistently oriented, and partially invalid triangle data remains an untrusted record until a strict build succeeds.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: A nonempty topology cannot contain an unused vertex.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Construction admits the fully empty topology with V, E, F, and H all zero. It rejects every partially empty topology with vertices but no incident faces. Explicit compaction may be added later and must return exact old/new maps.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: mesh4s uses four locus4s finite domains for vertices, edges, faces, and face-halfedges.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Cell-kind and owner mismatches are rejected by types after the initial dynamic ordinal check.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: The optimized representation uses one face-halfedge per triangle corner, so the halfedge count is exactly three times the face count.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Boundary edges have one face-halfedge and public opposite lookup is partial. No synthetic exterior halfedges are stored.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: Topology construction is strict and never repairs input.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Orientation, compaction, and later repair operations are separately named transformations with explicit reports and correspondence values.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: Topology auditing is bounded and staged.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Hostile files cannot force an unbounded diagnostic result, and an audit records which global stages were conclusive.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: SurfaceRealization does not claim to be an embedding.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Finite vertex coordinates are accepted without claiming nondegeneracy, injectivity, or freedom from self-intersection.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: PiecewiseEuclideanMetric is a peer of SurfaceRealization rather than a cached implementation detail.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Intrinsic algorithms can depend on edge lengths and units without requiring ambient coordinates.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: Cell-associated data uses locus4s Field, Region, Selection, typed maps, and Relation.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: mesh4s will not create VertexData, FaceData, SurfaceField, or a dynamic property-map hierarchy.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: The spatial4s extraction runs in parallel with topology development.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: mesh4s-core can begin against locus4s, but mesh4s-geometry cannot freeze until the shared frame and coordinate contract is available.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: Graph conversion is an optional, named forgetful projection.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: TriangleTopology stores no graph and graph algorithms cannot silently replace surface incidence or surface metric semantics.

accepted_design_decisions.decision: Runtime topology equality is owner identity.
accepted_design_decisions.consequence: Structural comparison, persistence alignment, and later isomorphism are explicit operations with explicit costs.
Construction reports, orientation flip fields, and topology-associated values use locus4s Field without introducing another field abstraction.

dependency_rules.constraint: The reference implementation must not reuse the optimized builder's primitive tables or traversal implementation.

external_workstreams.name: spatial4s-core extraction
owns: Frame identity, records, registries, and alignment
mesh4s_release_blocking_scope: Implement and publish spatial4s-core at the exact revision consumed by mesh4s-geometry.

non_blocking_follow_up_migrations.work: Retain grid-specific concepts in image4s and provide temporary re-exports of migrated neutral spatial types.
Migrate reframe4s to import Frame, Point, Vec, and affine primitives directly from spatial4s.

external_workstreams.integration_rule: mesh4s-geometry depends directly on spatial4s-core. image4s and reframe4s migrations are tracked by their own repositories and do not block mesh4s 0.1.

trusted_topology.name: TriangleTopology
invariants: Each face contains exactly three distinct in-domain vertices.
Duplicate faces are absent independent of cyclic rotation and reversal.
Each edge has one or two incident face-halfedges.
Two incident faces traverse their shared edge in opposite directions.
Each interior vertex link is one cycle.
Each boundary vertex link is one path.
Every vertex of a nonempty topology is incident to at least one face.
The empty topology is admitted only when V, E, F, and H are all zero.
The topology is immutable after construction.
The halfedge count equals three times the face count.
Three times the face count equals twice the interior-edge count plus the boundary-edge count.
All primitive stores are addressable by the supported runtime.

canonical_primitive_storage.name: faceVertices
canonical_primitive_storage.meaning: Origin vertex ordinal for each face-halfedge.

canonical_primitive_storage.name: oppositeHalfedge
canonical_primitive_storage.meaning: Opposite face-halfedge ordinal or a private boundary sentinel.

canonical_primitive_storage.name: halfedgeOfEdge
canonical_primitive_storage.meaning: One representative face-halfedge for each edge.

canonical_primitive_storage.name: halfedgeOfVertex
canonical_primitive_storage.meaning: One representative outgoing face-halfedge for each vertex.

deterministic_indexing: Vertex order is the supplied finite-domain order.
Face order is the input row order.
Halfedge order is face-major with local corners zero through two.
Edge order is first occurrence in face-major halfedge order.
The canonical chain orientation of an edge runs from the lower vertex ordinal to the higher ordinal.
Hash-table iteration cannot determine any public ordinal.

complexity_contract.operation: faceOf, origin, target, next, previous, edgeOf, opposite, face vertices, edge endpoints
vertex fan, neighbor traversal, incident-face traversal
components, boundary loops, full topological summary

functional_requirements.requirement: Initialize mesh4s as a version-controlled Scala 3.7.4 multi-project build targeting JVM and Scala.js.
acceptance_criteria: Git is initialized and prd.json is committed before implementation work begins so later scope revisions have a durable record.
The build has named modules for core, geometry, reference, laws, and graph4s integration.
Scala 3.7.4 is pinned explicitly, and compiler-version changes require a reviewed build update.
The build uses the agreed sbt-typelevel settings for cross-project organization, publishing, and documentation.
Strict compiler warnings and formatting checks are enabled.
A fresh checkout can compile all JVM and Scala.js modules from documented commands.

functional_requirements.requirement: Pin each source dependency to an immutable revision and support explicit local development overrides.
acceptance_criteria: The default build does not depend on an uncommitted sibling checkout.
Local overrides are clearly reported by the build.
Release certification records the exact locus4s, spatial4s, and graph4s revisions.

functional_requirements.requirement: Compile representative dependent-type signatures before implementing primitive storage.
acceptance_criteria: Ordinary application code can name topology-local vertex, edge, face, and halfedge indices without supplying four explicit type parameters.
Compile-negative examples reject a face where a vertex is required.
Compile-negative examples reject a vertex from another topology.
Public overloads do not rely only on opaque Int index types for JVM method distinction.

functional_requirements.requirement: Run the release verification matrix in continuous integration.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs formatting and strict compilation checks.
CI runs JVM and Scala.js unit and law suites.
CI performs Scala.js FullOpt linking.
CI compiles the executable documentation.
CI records the exact dependency revisions and fails when the default build needs an unpublished sibling checkout.

functional_requirements.requirement: Declare the binary-compatibility policy before publishing 0.1.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-0.1 builds may change without a MiMa baseline.
The published 0.1 artifacts become the MiMa baseline for subsequent compatible releases.
Any later compatibility exclusion requires a documented rationale in the repository.

functional_requirements.requirement: Freeze one shared spatial identity and coordinate contract for image4s, mesh4s, and reframe4s.
acceptance_criteria: Frame supports ephemeral and caller-supplied persistent identity.
Independent restoration requires explicit alignment.
The contract defines the Frame owner used directly by Point and Vec and designates that API as the migration target for image4s and reframe4s.
mesh4s does not wait for the image4s or reframe4s migration after the contract is frozen.
CoordinateUnit can represent length, dimensionless, and validated custom units.
CoordinateConvention is extensible beyond RAS, LPS, and unspecified.
The contract documentation states that spatial4s.Frame is a coordinate frame and is unrelated to the frame4s typed dataframe library.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement and publish the frozen spatial4s-core contract consumed by mesh4s-geometry.
acceptance_criteria: The published API implements the approved Frame, Point, Vec, unit, convention, identity, registry, alignment, and affine contracts.
JVM and Scala.js identity and coordinate-law suites pass.
mesh4s-geometry resolves the exact published or immutable source revision without importing image4s or reframe4s.

functional_requirements.requirement: Represent vertices, edges, faces, and face-halfedges as four topology-owned locus4s finite domains.
acceptance_criteria: Each public cell index is owned by exactly one topology and one cell kind.
Dynamic ordinals are checked when entering a domain and topology operations are total afterward.
No public VertexId, FaceId, invalid-cell sentinel, or raw Int cell API competes with the typed indices.

functional_requirements.requirement: Provide an inspectable untrusted TriangleTable that does not expose trusted manifold operations.
acceptance_criteria: Codecs and tests can preserve ordered rows and vertex count without constructing a topology.
TriangleTable can be passed to inspect, strict build, and explicit orientation operations.
No method on TriangleTable claims manifold adjacency or boundary structure.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement strict construction from typed faces and ordinal triangle rows.
acceptance_criteria: Construction preserves supplied face and corner order.
Construction admits the empty topology only when the vertex count and every derived cell count are zero.
Construction accepts oriented triangular manifolds with boundary and multiple connected components.
Construction rejects invalid rows, duplicate faces, nonmanifold edges, orientation conflicts, nonmanifold vertex links, and unused vertices.
No boolean option enables repair, dropping, compaction, or automatic orientation.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement a bounded staged TopologyAudit with concrete witnesses.
acceptance_criteria: The caller can set an issue limit.
The result records whether diagnostics were truncated.
The result records which audit stages completed.
Each issue reports the relevant face, corner, vertex, edge endpoints, or witness faces.
Invalid local faces do not produce misleading claims that every downstream global stage was fully checked.

functional_requirements.requirement: Compile a trusted topology into the canonical face-corner primitive tables.
acceptance_criteria: The halfedge count equals three times the face count.
Boundary state is represented only by a private primitive sentinel.
No object is stored per cell.
All public indexing rules are deterministic and tested.

functional_requirements.requirement: Expose total constant-time local incidence and allocation-conscious primitive traversal.
acceptance_criteria: origin, target, next, previous, faceOf, edgeOf, face vertices, and edge endpoints are total for valid typed indices.
opposite returns None only for a boundary edge.
foreachNeighbor, foreachIncidentFace, foreachFaceHalfedge, and foreachBoundaryHalfedge avoid per-cell index-wrapper allocation.
Convenience collection materialization is separately documented as allocating.

functional_requirements.requirement: Represent interior vertex rings and boundary vertex fans without hiding their different ordering semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Interior fan traversal is cyclic.
Boundary fan traversal is a path with two boundary ends.
A fan stores one ordered halfedge traversal and derives faces and neighbors from it.
Deterministic materialization uses the documented canonical start and orientation.

functional_requirements.requirement: Expose deterministic boundary loops, components, Euler characteristic, and topological summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary loops are disjoint directed cycles covering every boundary halfedge exactly once.
Component order and loop order are deterministic.
Full summaries run in O(V + H).
Closedness and connectedness checks can retain reusable evidence.

functional_requirements.requirement: Expose signed edge and face boundary incidence as an oriented chain complex.
acceptance_criteria: Each edge is oriented from lower to higher vertex ordinal.
Primitive callbacks emit only coefficients plus typed cell indices.
Public methods have distinct JVM-safe names for edge and face boundary traversal.
The exact law boundary1 composed with boundary2 equals zero holds for every constructed topology.

functional_requirements.requirement: Provide an explicit deterministic orientAndBuild operation.
acceptance_criteria: The operation first rejects out-of-domain or repeated face vertices, duplicate faces, and edges with more than two incident faces using the ordinary bounded audit witnesses.
Orientation components are the connected components of the face graph whose adjacency is shared undirected edges, not shared vertices.
The first face orientation in each face-graph component is preserved.
Face row order is preserved.
The operation returns the exact face-flip Field over the result topology's Face domain, whose ordinals correspond to the unchanged input row order.
A parity contradiction returns a cycle witness for nonorientability.
After orienting, strict construction can still reject a nonmanifold vertex link, an unused vertex, or another invariant outside the orientation problem.
The operation never claims to choose an outward orientation.

functional_requirements.requirement: Provide evidence-bearing closed and connected views without encoding all properties as phantom flags.
acceptance_criteria: requireClosed returns either a boundary report or closed evidence.
requireConnected returns either component evidence or a connected view.
Computed certificates can be reused by downstream algorithms.
Ordinary topology construction does not require closedness or connectedness.

functional_requirements.requirement: Define a versioned topology record with one authoritative topology key and deterministic incidence.
acceptance_criteria: The record contains the topology key, vertex-domain record, ordered face vertex ordinals, indexing-scheme version, and connectivity fingerprint.
Face, edge, and halfedge domain identities are derived deterministically instead of supplied as independent authorities.
The record rejects a fingerprint that does not match its canonical incidence bytes.

functional_requirements.requirement: Define a versioned SHA-256 topology fingerprint over canonical bytes.
acceptance_criteria: The byte encoding includes only the fingerprint scheme version, vertex count, and ordered triangle rows.
The fingerprint excludes runtime owner tokens, TopologyKey, DomainKey, display metadata, and registry state.
Two topologies with the same vertex count and ordered triangle rows have the same connectivity fingerprint even when their vertex domains are ephemeral and independently owned.
JVM and Scala.js produce identical golden fingerprints.
A fingerprint is structural evidence only. It never authorizes index transport, creates identity, or replaces a full incidence check during alignment.

functional_requirements.requirement: Restore persistent topologies through an immutable registry that incorporates locus4s domain restoration.
acceptance_criteria: The registry is a persistent threaded value: restore returns the updated registry together with the restored topology owner.
Repeated restoration through the returned registry value returns the canonical owner.
A conflicting record for an existing topology key is rejected.
Restoration in independent registries produces independent owners that cannot be mixed without alignment.
The 0.1 contract contains no global mutable or concurrent registry.

functional_requirements.requirement: Provide exact TopologyAlignment for independently restored copies of the same ordered topology.
acceptance_criteria: Alignment validates all incidence once.
Alignment contains vertex, edge, face, and halfedge domain alignments.
Transport after validation is ordinal-preserving and O(1).
Identity, inverse, and associative composition laws hold.
Changed ordering or incidence is rejected rather than treated as alignment.

functional_requirements.requirement: Keep runtime equality, structural comparison, alignment, and isomorphism as separate operations.
acceptance_criteria: Ordinary equality is O(1) owner identity.
sameConnectivity has an explicit linear cost.
align requires equal ordered persistent topology.
No automatic topology-isomorphism search is present in 0.1.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement a frame-owned packed PointField over a locus4s domain.
acceptance_criteria: The frame is stored once per field rather than once per point.
Packed float and double implementations are supported or the storage extension point is documented.
coordinate access and D2 or D3 primitive traversal do not allocate Point objects per element.
point(index) remains available as a semantic convenience.
Bulk interleaved float and double export supports renderers and codecs.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement SurfaceRealization as finite coordinates over one exact topology in one typed frame.
acceptance_criteria: Construction checks the exact topology vertex domain.
Construction rejects non-finite coordinates.
Construction copies input or retains only storage with documented immutable ownership.
The base type does not claim nondegeneracy, injectivity, or absence of self-intersections.
No secondary untyped surfaceToWorld matrix is stored.

functional_requirements.requirement: Allow any number of realizations to share one exact topology.
acceptance_criteria: White, pial, inflated, and spherical coordinates can share vertex indices and fields.
Equal vertex counts alone do not establish compatibility.
A realization from another topology owner requires exact alignment before transport.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement a unit-bearing PiecewiseEuclideanMetric over topology edges.
acceptance_criteria: Edge lengths are stored as an immutable locus4s Field or compatible primitive field implementation.
Every edge length is finite and strictly positive.
Every face satisfies a strict triangle inequality on the stored Double values: each sum of two edge lengths is greater than the third.
The exact stored-value check has no hidden epsilon and cannot be relaxed by a tolerance.
An optional explicit conditioning policy may require a larger scale-aware inequality margin and reports faces that are mathematically valid but numerically ill-conditioned.
The metric carries a coordinate unit even when no ambient realization exists.

functional_requirements.requirement: Allow a nondegenerate realization to induce and retain an intrinsic metric.
acceptance_criteria: Induced edge lengths are symmetric and use the realization's coordinate unit.
The certification path verifies the same exact stored-Double triangle inequalities required by direct metric construction.
If floating-point rounding collapses a sliver triangle to equality, certification fails with a numerical-degeneracy witness rather than accepting a non-metric edge table.
Rigid transformations preserve the induced metric within the documented numerical policy.
Intrinsic face areas agree with realization areas within the documented tolerance.

functional_requirements.requirement: Provide explicit scale-aware nondegeneracy certification.
acceptance_criteria: The caller supplies or selects a documented tolerance policy.
Certification combines the scale-aware area policy with the exact stored-edge triangle-inequality check.
Failure reports the degenerate face witnesses.
Success retains reusable face-area and induced-metric evidence.
No global floating-point epsilon is hidden in topology construction.

functional_requirements.requirement: Provide only geometry operations with an unambiguous 0.1 contract.
acceptance_criteria: The API includes edge vectors, squared lengths, lengths, face centroids, bounding boxes, and total area.
D2 includes signed face area.
D3 includes vector area, unsigned area, and evidence-requiring unit face normals.
Barycentric operations state how off-plane residual is handled in D3.
No unqualified vertexNormals or curvature method appears.

functional_requirements.requirement: Project a topology to its unweighted primal graph without storing that graph in the topology.
acceptance_criteria: The graph has exactly one graph vertex per mesh vertex.
The graph has exactly one graph edge per mesh edge.
The result retains total mesh-to-indexed-graph vertex and edge correspondence.
Projection laws compare adjacency with the topology oracle.

functional_requirements.requirement: Project a topology to its interior dual graph.
acceptance_criteria: The dual graph has one vertex per mesh face.
The dual graph has one edge per interior mesh edge.
Boundary mesh edges map to no dual graph edge.
The result retains the interior-edge correspondence.

functional_requirements.requirement: Keep topology-only and metric-weighted graph projections as distinct named operations.
acceptance_criteria: The topology-only projection does not require geometry.
A metric-weighted projection receives an explicit metric or weighting policy.
The API does not imply that a graph Laplacian is a surface Laplace-Beltrami discretization.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement an independent map-and-set topology oracle.
acceptance_criteria: The oracle does not call optimized construction or traversal internals.
It independently computes edges, incidence, vertex links, components, and boundary loops.
Generated valid and malformed inputs produce equivalent outcomes and witnesses where ordering is specified.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement independent basic-geometry formulas for law comparison.
acceptance_criteria: Optimized edge lengths, areas, centroids, normals, metrics, and barycentric results agree within explicit tolerances.
The oracle uses a representation independent of packed PointField kernels.

functional_requirements.requirement: Provide generators for valid surfaces and precise malformed witnesses.
acceptance_criteria: Valid generators cover disks, annuli, spheres, tori, disconnected unions, and boundary patches.
Malformed generators cover out-of-range vertices, repeated corners, duplicate faces, three-face edges, orientation conflicts, bow-tie vertices, unused vertices, and nonorientable parity cycles.
Generator shrinking preserves the condition being tested.

functional_requirements.requirement: Package ownership, face-cycle, opposite, manifold, boundary, chain, and orientation laws.
acceptance_criteria: Law sets run against optimized and reference representations where applicable.
The chain law is checked exactly.
JVM and Scala.js execute the topology law suites.

functional_requirements.requirement: Add compile-time ownership tests.
acceptance_criteria: A face cannot be passed to a vertex operation.
A vertex from another topology cannot be passed without alignment.
An image-grid index cannot be passed as a mesh vertex.
Positive examples remain concise and do not require public type projections.

functional_requirements.requirement: Activate persistence, restoration, fingerprint, and alignment laws when the persistence phase lands.
acceptance_criteria: Record round trips, registry canonicalization, modified-incidence rejection, and alignment groupoid laws run on JVM and Scala.js.
Golden connectivity fingerprints agree across platforms.
The law suite proves that matching fingerprints alone do not authorize index transport.

functional_requirements.requirement: Activate realization, nondegeneracy, metric, and basic-geometry laws when mesh4s-geometry lands.
acceptance_criteria: Optimized and reference geometry agree within stated tolerances.
Rigid-motion, induced-metric, exact triangle-inequality, and conditioning-policy laws run on JVM and Scala.js.
Every floating-point law states and justifies its tolerance.

functional_requirements.requirement: Activate primal, weighted-primal, and interior-dual projection laws when mesh4s-graph4s lands.
acceptance_criteria: The primal graph has total vertex and edge correspondence.
The interior dual has one graph edge per interior mesh edge and none for a boundary mesh edge.
Topology-only and metric-weighted projections remain distinct in the law API.

functional_requirements.requirement: Audit every current ScalaFIM surface fixture and decoder output against the strict topology contract.
acceptance_criteria: Every rejected fixture has a recorded issue witness.
Inconsistent tetrahedron and spherical winding is corrected or passed through orientAndBuild with an asserted flip report.
Bow-tie or graph-star fixtures are replaced by valid manifolds or moved to graph-focused tests.
No strictness rule is weakened solely to preserve a malformed legacy fixture.

functional_requirements.requirement: Implement a temporary ScalaFIM TriangleMesh compatibility facade over TriangleTopology plus SurfaceRealization.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy call sites can migrate incrementally.
The facade does not retain a second adjacency or identity authority.
VertexId and FaceId are deprecated with a documented replacement.
White, pial, inflated, and spherical surfaces can share one topology owner.

functional_requirements.requirement: Replace ScalaFIM's parallel surface data algebra with locus4s structures.
acceptance_criteria: Full SurfaceField delegates to Field without copying into a second owner hierarchy.
ROI support uses Region.
Ordered subsets use Selection.
Labels use PartialSurjection plus a parcel metadata Field.
Vertex mappings use the strongest applicable locus4s map and field pullback.
SurfaceLocusDomain no longer performs whole-field or whole-topology conversion.

functional_requirements.requirement: Migrate surface rendering to packed coordinate output and an explicit normal-weighting policy.
acceptance_criteria: The render compiler does not allocate one Point per vertex.
Normal weighting is named and tested.
The packed output checksum agrees with the compatibility implementation on valid fixtures.

functional_requirements.requirement: Separate graph edge-path distance from future continuous surface geodesics.
acceptance_criteria: The current Dijkstra operation is named EdgePathDistance or an equally explicit term.
No API labels an edge-weighted graph shortest path as an exact surface geodesic.
A future geodesic API can depend on PiecewiseEuclideanMetric without compatibility ambiguity.

functional_requirements.requirement: Complete a representative neuroimaging vertical slice before the 0.1 release.
acceptance_criteria: One topology owns white, pial, inflated, and spherical realizations.
Thickness and labels use locus4s fields over the shared vertex domain.
The renderer consumes packed coordinates.
One explicit graph projection is exercised.
One FreeSurfer or GIFTI fixture reaches strict construction directly or through explicit orientation.

functional_requirements.requirement: Document the concrete multi-realization use case before explaining halfedge storage or persistence machinery.
acceptance_criteria: The first executable guide builds one topology from coordinate rows and triangle rows.
The guide attaches at least two realizations and one vertex field.
The guide demonstrates compile-time rejection of a wrong cell kind or owner.
The guide explains boundary and orientation failures with runnable examples.

functional_requirements.requirement: Publish explicit public contracts for ordering, complexity, allocation, identity, and numerical tolerance.
acceptance_criteria: Users can distinguish guarantees from implementation details.
Every materializing convenience method documents its allocation behavior.
Every numerical certification names its tolerance policy.
Persistence documentation distinguishes owner identity, alignment, and isomorphism.

functional_requirements.requirement: Disambiguate spatial4s.Frame from the unrelated frame4s typed dataframe library at the first introduction of frames.
acceptance_criteria: The README and first spatial4s-linked guide define Frame as a typed coordinate frame.
The same paragraph states that frame4s is a separate typed dataframe project.
Package names are shown in the first potentially ambiguous code example.

nonfunctional_requirements.requirement: A successfully constructed TriangleTopology must satisfy all documented manifold and orientation laws without requiring defensive checks in ordinary queries.
Public mesh4s values are immutable. Builders may use private mutation but publish only fully validated immutable results.

Equivalent vertex counts and ordered triangle rows produce identical public cell ordinals, traversal materializations, and structural fingerprints across JVM and Scala.js; owner identity remains separate.
Primitive local traversal performs work proportional to the visited incidence and does not allocate a typed cell object per visited cell.
The optimized topology stores primitive arrays proportional to V, E, and F and does not retain duplicate adjacency or graph stores.
All 0.1 public artifacts except format-specific JVM codecs compile and test on JVM and Scala.js.
The mesh4s release-artifact dependency graph has one finite-identity authority and one spatial frame authority.
Construction failures identify bounded concrete witnesses suitable for a codec error report or repair workflow.
Compatibility facades may preserve source migration paths but cannot retain parallel identity, topology, field, or adjacency authorities.
All primary documentation examples compile as part of the build.
Every pushed change runs the documented JVM, Scala.js, formatting, and documentation matrix before it can be treated as release evidence.
The published 0.1 artifacts establish the binary-compatibility baseline for subsequent compatible releases.

performance_courts.criterion: Visited cell count may grow while typed cell-wrapper allocation remains constant or absent after warmup.
Matched traversal checksums and generated-code inspection show no cell-object construction in the hot loop.
Construction and full traversal scale linearly over matched 1x, 2x, and 4x generated meshes.
Renderer and export kernels consume primitive coordinates without materializing a full Point collection.
Observed retained topology storage is consistent with the documented primitive-array formula and contains no duplicate graph adjacency store.

fresh_checkout_gates: Scala.js compile, test, and full link.

release_criteria.criterion: Every P1 functional requirement is complete or explicitly removed from the 0.1 scope through a recorded PRD revision.
The trusted topology passes the full valid and malformed generator court against the independent reference implementation.
JVM and Scala.js agree on deterministic ordinals, traversal checksums, record round trips, and fingerprint golden vectors.
Primitive incidence and coordinate traversal meet the allocation and scaling courts.
The ScalaFIM multi-realization vertical slice passes without a second public surface identity, field, or adjacency hierarchy.
Fresh checkouts resolve and build the exact dependency revisions without relying on unpublished sibling-directory state.
The README begins with a runnable triangle-row and multiple-realization workflow, distinguishes spatial4s.Frame from frame4s, and all documentation examples compile.
The CI matrix is green for formatting, JVM, Scala.js, FullOpt linking, and documentation, and the post-0.1 MiMa baseline policy is configured.

risks.risk: The spatial4s extraction expands into a long cross-repository migration and delays geometry.
risks.mitigation: Run topology and spatial work as parallel lanes. Freeze and implement only the minimal spatial4s contract required by mesh4s-geometry. Track image4s and reframe4s migrations as non-blocking work in their own repositories.
risks.trigger: PH1A cannot produce a compiling shared contract while PH1B is otherwise ready.

risks.risk: Published or pinned dependency revisions do not contain the inspected local contracts.
risks.mitigation: Use exact immutable revisions, record local overrides, and require a fresh-checkout dependency court before integration and release claims.
risks.trigger: A clean checkout fails to compile without a sibling working tree.

risks.risk: Path-dependent Scala types make ordinary APIs difficult to use or produce JVM erasure conflicts.
risks.mitigation: Complete compile-only API spikes before storage implementation. Prefer stable topology paths, local aliases, and distinct method names.
risks.trigger: Examples require public type projections or explicit V, E, F, and H parameters.

risks.risk: Strict manifold construction rejects a significant portion of existing ScalaFIM fixtures or external files.
risks.mitigation: Keep TriangleTable and inspect available, implement explicit orientation early, and distinguish malformed surface data from graph-only test fixtures.
risks.trigger: Admission auditing shows widespread nonmanifold data rather than isolated winding problems.

risks.risk: Diagnostic accumulation consumes excessive memory on hostile files.
risks.mitigation: Make issue limits and bounded witness sets part of the first audit implementation.
risks.trigger: Diagnostic memory grows with the total number of malformed rows after reaching the configured issue limit.

risks.risk: Point convenience APIs leak allocations into renderers and numerical kernels.
risks.mitigation: Design primitive PointField access before SurfaceRealization and gate the ScalaFIM renderer on allocation evidence.
risks.trigger: Hot-loop profiles show Point or Vec construction proportional to vertex or face count.

risks.risk: Fingerprint or derived-cell identity rules change after data has been persisted.
risks.mitigation: Version the byte encoding and indexing scheme from the first release and maintain golden vectors.
risks.trigger: A code change alters record bytes or cell ordinals without an explicit schema-version change.

risks.risk: Graph-weighted operations are mistaken for intrinsic surface algorithms.
risks.mitigation: Use explicit topology-only, metric-weighted, edge-path, FEM, and DEC names. Keep stiffness and mass structures out of the graph projection API.
risks.trigger: An API or example calls graph shortest-path distance a surface geodesic or graph spectral decomposition a surface Laplace-Beltrami method.

open_decisions.decision: Select the Maven organization, artifact names, GitHub account, and publication repository.

open_decisions.decision: Choose the exact locus4s revision that defines the 0.1 ownership and Field contract.
open_decisions.recommended_resolution: Select a committed revision containing the reviewed foundation API and prove it through a fresh-checkout JVM and Scala.js build.

open_decisions.decision: Finalize the open representation of CoordinateUnit and CoordinateConvention.
open_decisions.recommended_resolution: Support standard length units plus dimensionless and validated custom identifiers; do not use a closed enum that excludes spherical, inflated, or surface-specific frames.

open_decisions.decision: Finalize PointField storage extension points and float-versus-double construction policies.
open_decisions.recommended_resolution: Expose semantic Double access, provide packed float and double stores, and require constructors to state whether they copy or own the supplied storage.

open_decisions.decision: Select the first format fixture for the release vertical slice.
open_decisions.recommended_resolution: Use one small FreeSurfer or GIFTI fixture whose topology, coordinates, orientation report, and expected field values can be checked into the test suite.
